name: Depth-based Adaptive Raycasting with LOD
aliases: EA-raycasting with LOD and Depth-based Step Size
Front-to-Back Volume Raycasting with Early Termination and LOD
definition: A GPU-based volume raycasting method that uses front-to-back alpha blending (emission-absorption) with Level-of-Detail (LOD) selection and variable sampling step sizes based on depth to optimize performance.
summary: Depth-based Adaptive Raycasting with LOD optimizes volume rendering by varying sampling step size based on ray depth, reducing computational cost in distant regions while maintaining high resolution near the viewer.
